reproduction_target: The ancient-metagenomics analysis chain reported in Methods 6.3: fastp/SGA/FastQC read QC, bowtie2 contaminant removal, bowtie2 mapping against a GTDB r226 representative-genome database, ngsLCA taxonomic assignment, bamdam damage/decontamination filtering, sylph cross-check, NMDS ordination of subglacial classes, OxyMetaG aerobe/anaerobe prediction, plus the Fe-Mn/Eh calcite geochemical model and the figure-generation R script. Wet-lab steps (U-Th dating, ICP-OES elemental measurement, ancient-DNA extraction/library prep/sequencing) are OOS.
granularity_note: Stage-1 prose triage: one step per named tool/analysis invocation in Methods 6.1-6.3 plus the Data/Code availability statements. The repository landing page and README prose were read (README states only: 'The code folder contains the bash scripts used to process the metagenomics data, and an R script used to make the figures, the latter which runs on input files all available in the data folder.'); no workflow file (Snakefile/Nextflow/CWL/WDL/Makefile) is advertised on the landing page, so the prose-methods anchor was used rather than a workflow anchor. MAG assembly and functional annotation are named in Author Contributions and Results but their tools/parameters live only in the Supplement, which was not retrieved; that step is scored on main-text evidence alone and flagged as needs-supplement.

steps.label: fastp read merging, adapter removal (custom Illumina adapter text file), poly-G/poly-X trimming, duplicate removal, low-complexity filter, mean-quality<25 and length<30 discard, merged-reads-only retention
SGA low-complexity read removal (dust threshold 30, ropebwt algorithm, no kmer check)
FastQC per-library quality assessment and truncation of all filtered merged reads to 150 bp

bowtie2 v2.4.4 mapping of samples and controls against human/pig/chicken/cow reference genomes (GCF_000001405.40, GCF_000003025.6, GCF_016699485.2, GCF_002263795) with default parameters; samtools removal of mapped contaminant reads

GTDB v226.0 reference database construction (release226/226.0/genomic_files_reps/gtdb_genomes_reps_r226.tar.gz, released 2025-04-16, accessed 2025-06-25; 143,614 representative genomes concatenated into 15 fasta files, 455 GB uncompressed) and taxonomy file generation with gtdb_to_taxdump
bowtie2 mapping of samples and controls against the 15 GTDB reference fasta pieces (-k 100, -N 1, defaults otherwise)
samtools BAM post-processing: strip unused reference names from headers, merge BAMs across database pieces, query-sort merged BAMs
ngsLCA lowest-common-ancestor read assignment at minimum similarity 95% for all samples and controls

bamdam shrink + compute on the 7 negative controls (single-stranded mode, minimum read count 10, taxonomic level phylum, minimum similarity 95%, defaults otherwise) yielding the 930-node contaminant exclusion list (>50 reads in any control)

bamdam on the 30 samples incl. surface control (single-stranded, level phylum or below, min similarity 95%, per-node exclusion of the 930 control taxa), replicate BAM/LCA merging, and re-run on merged pairs to yield 26 unique samples; plus the no-exclusion control run on all 26
Damage-coloured Krona plot generation with bamdam krona and KronaTools ktImportXML (published at https://bdesanctis.github.io/subglacial-precipitates/kronas.html)
sylph v0.6.1 metagenomic profiling cross-check on all samples and controls with default options against the GTDB database
bamdam combine to transform bamdam outputs into per-node abundance and damage matrices

Designation of 19 subglacial classes (16 bacteria, 3 archaea) from read counts and damage values at a class-level taxonomic cutoff, per Supplementary Figure 3; extraction of the 4390 subglacial taxonomic nodes from the bamdam TSVs
NMDS ordination via metaMDS (R vegan) on unaggregated read counts for the 4390 subglacial nodes, restricted to samples with >200 reads (EM1, PM1, SC1 and all negative controls discarded)
OxyMetaG 'profile' on subglacial-bacterial read subsets to quantify abundances of 20 oxygen-tolerance marker genes (13 aerobic, 7 anaerobic)

OxyMetaG 'predict -m custom' aerobe-fraction prediction via the simulated-metagenome GAM, relaxed cutoffs (percent identity >=45%, e-value <0.1, bitscore >=25; stringent check at >=60% / <0.001), retaining samples with >=3 markers detected (5 oxidized + 12 reduced samples)

Metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) assembly and functional annotation (one-carbon metabolism / cooS-acsA Wood-Ljungdahl gene calls, early-branching ancient MAG) — attributed in Author Contributions and used in Results, but no assembler, binner, quality-assessment or annotation tool is named in the main text

Fe-Mn calcite / Eh redox geochemical model adapted from reference [58], mapping water redox potential onto expected calcite Fe-Mn composition (batch rather than continuous pore-water evolution), compared against literature calcite datasets
Figure generation R script (tidyverse, rnaturalearth, sf, vegan) running on the input files in the repository data/ folder
234U-230Th dating of subglacial precipitates (analytical methods and isotopic data reported in references [14, 24, ...]); delta-18O, delta-13C and 234U/238U stable/radiogenic isotope measurement
Major/minor element (Fe, Mn) composition of calcite precipitates measured on a Thermo iCap 7400 ICP-OES; comparison speleothem Fe/Mn measured by LA-ICPMS

Ancient-DNA clean-lab work at UC Santa Cruz: bleach decontamination, powdering, silica-column extraction (binding buffer D), single-stranded library preparation, equimolar pooling, Illumina HiSeq 2x150 bp sequencing to ~12M reads/sample (37 libraries, 1.12 billion raw reads)

headline.static_readiness: 0/20 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 1/20 (5%) readiness upper bound (n_R-star + n_RI)/|S| - stage-1 prose ceiling, not a claim of reproducibility. The dominant blocker is not code availability but data: raw sequencing data are stated as 'will be deposited in the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) and made publicly available upon publication', with no accession given, so every step consuming sample reads scores data=0.
headline.coverage: 20/23 (87%) computational coverage |S|/(|S|+|W|); 3 wet-lab steps OOS (U-Th dating/isotopes, ICP-OES elemental analysis, ancient-DNA extraction-library-sequencing)

gaps.missing: Raw sequencing data are not deposited. Verbatim: 'Raw sequencing data will be deposited in the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) and made publicly available upon publication. All other data generated in this study are available in Supplementary Data 1.1-1.10.' No ENA study/project accession, no sample accessions, no sample-to-run correspondence table. 1.12 billion raw reads across 37 libraries are therefore unobtainable, which zeroes the data axis for 15 of 20 computational steps.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the 37 libraries in ENA/SRA and publish the study accession plus a sample-to-library/run mapping table; update the preprint's Data availability statement.

gaps.missing: 2a version-not-stated for the majority of tools: fastp, SGA, FastQC, samtools, gtdb_to_taxdump, ngsLCA, bamdam, KronaTools (ktImportXML), OxyMetaG, R itself, and the R packages tidyverse, rnaturalearth, sf, vegan. Only bowtie2 v2.4.4, sylph v0.6.1 and the GTDB database v226.0 carry exact pins.
gaps.how_to_close: State versions for all tools, or ship a conda-lock / renv.lock / container digest covering the declared platform.

gaps.missing: 2b floating code reference: the paper cites the bare repository URL. The landing page shows no published release and the paper cites no tag, commit SHA or archival DOI (no Zenodo/Software Heritage snapshot). The code the paper describes is whatever is on the mutable main branch at read time.
gaps.how_to_close: Cut a release, archive it to Zenodo, and cite the versioned DOI (or at minimum the commit SHA) in the Code availability statement.

gaps.where: Results section 3 / Author Contributions / step C18
gaps.missing: The MAG assembly and functional annotation sub-pipeline is externalized: 'NBD performed the functional annotation and MAG assembly' and Results report assembled MAGs and cooS/acsA gene calls, but the main text names no assembler, binner, completeness estimator or annotation tool and gives no parameters. The Supplement was not retrieved at stage 1.
gaps.how_to_close: Bring the MAG assembly/annotation tool chain, versions and parameters into Methods (or verify the Supplement covers them) and confirm the corresponding scripts are in the code/ folder.

gaps.missing: The GTDB reference database is pinned in PROSE only, though unusually well (exact tarball path release226/226.0/genomic_files_reps/gtdb_genomes_reps_r226.tar.gz, release date 2025-04-16, access date 2025-06-25, 143,614 genomes, 455 GB). Whether the repository's bash scripts fetch this pinned artifact (class A) or consume a user-supplied local path (class B) is unverified at stage 1. The 15-way splitting scheme of the concatenated fastas is also not specified, and split boundaries affect the -k 100 alignment-retention behaviour.
gaps.how_to_close: Stage 2: read the download/reference-build rule in code/ and assign env_capture_class. Authors could add a download script pinning the exact tarball URL plus a checksum, and record the fasta-splitting scheme.

gaps.missing: fastp adapter removal used 'a custom text file containing standard Illumina adapters and residues'. The file itself is not described or stated as deposited; the low-complexity filter threshold used within fastp is also unstated (the SGA dust threshold of 30 is stated, the fastp one is not).
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the adapter FASTA/text file in the repository and state the fastp complexity threshold.

gaps.missing: 'Computations were done primarily on the UCSC Genomics Institute computing server.' Site-specific paths, module loads or scheduler assumptions in the bash scripts are plausible but NOT verified at stage 1 - flagged as a stage-2 check, not scored as a confirmed gap.
gaps.how_to_close: Stage 2: static-analyse code/ for hardcoded absolute paths and cluster-specific invocations.

gaps.missing: Three wet-lab steps (U-Th dating and isotope geochemistry, ICP-OES/LA-ICPMS Fe-Mn measurement, ancient-DNA extraction/library/sequencing) are non-computational and excluded from |S| as OOS. Recorded for coverage accounting, not as a defect.
gaps.how_to_close: n/a - out of scope for NASEM-2019 computational reproducibility.
